description: Double claps (clap, brief pause, clap), seven of them, about 3 s apart (0-19.5 s); then four single claps about 3 s apart (23-34 s); then both hands in view, not clapping (35.5-39.6 s). Only the seven double claps should count; the second clap came 560-760 ms after the first. Frames with no hands weren't recorded, so the gaps between claps have no frames. Recorded from a live webcam at 640x480 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every frame (~35 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
